verdict.rationale: Lovable clearly lets you take your code and leave: you can download the codebase, sync it to a GitHub or GitLab repo you own, and deploy outside Lovable. The backend sits on Supabase's open-source foundation and offers direct SQL editor access, which suggests the data is reachable. However, nothing documents a full export of database contents, auth users or stored files in open formats. Missing for 10: documented export of database data, auth user records and storage files; a migration-off-platform guide; independent hands-on corroboration of a full exit.
